top_signals.title: Aging Boomers Are Key Factor Supporting Corporate Bond Market
top_signals.summary: Ordinary Americans seeking to lock in relatively high income have been surprisingly heavy buyers of US corporate bonds this year, emerging as an important source of demand for the securities even as yields have soared in recent months.
